scope: Public answer roles and representations only; no expected answer values or private required source coordinates. Original tasks and frozen scorer are unchanged.
selection: Explicit evaluation overlay for these 28 already exposed regression QA tasks; it does not change public MCP tools.

ambiguityDecisions.meaning: guard is the positive name-collision predicate, not the insertion branch condition.
Both semantic choices are public enum tokens; select from implementation.
direction describes complete scan order with the public hyphenated enum spelling.
The track collection is an array of string values sorted lexicographically; module identities remain distinct during retrieval.
Argument fields are simple identifiers in source call order; receivers are omitted.

storageType.description: Declared collection type expression used to store seen request IDs. Preserve generic arguments and the source type spelling; do not reduce it to a simple class name, add an undeclared package, or include explanation.

method.description: Method that checks or rejects duplicate requests. Use only its simple identifier; omit package, owner, receiver, arguments, signature and explanation.

field.description: Java receipt field carrying the amount. Use only its simple identifier; omit package, owner, receiver, arguments, signature and explanation.

column.description: XML column name mapped to that field. Return the exact string value without explanation; do not alter punctuation, case or whitespace.

assembler.description: Method assembling the receipt from the input amount. Use only its simple identifier; omit package, owner, receiver, arguments, signature and explanation.

rejectsZero.description: Whether the implementation rejects zero quantity.

rejectsOverAvailable.description: Whether it rejects quantity greater than available stock.

entry.description: Cancellation entry method. Use only its simple identifier; omit package, owner, receiver, arguments, signature and explanation.

callee.description: Method called to return reserved stock. Use only its simple identifier; omit package, owner, receiver, arguments, signature and explanation.

stateField.description: Reservation field recording the cancellation state. Use only its simple identifier; omit package, owner, receiver, arguments, signature and explanation.

method.description: Policy method deciding temporary access. Use only its simple identifier; omit package, owner, receiver, arguments, signature and explanation.

parameters.description: Simple names of the two compared parameters, in declaration order. Do not return objects or qualified expressions.

endpoint.description: Entry method for the route named by the question. Use only its simple identifier; omit package, owner, receiver, arguments, signature and explanation.

delegate.description: Policy method called by that entry. Use only its simple identifier; omit package, owner, receiver, arguments, signature and explanation.

tracks.description: String values returned by track in both modules. Include both declarations. Sort values lexicographically using code-point order; return strings only, without module/path objects.

decision.description: Method making the admission decision. Use only its simple identifier; omit package, owner, receiver, arguments, signature and explanation.

format.description: Method formatting the display status, not a response-format label. Use only its simple identifier; omit package, owner, receiver, arguments, signature and explanation.

accepted.description: String literal returned by the display-status method for an admitted applicant, not the boolean decision result. Return the exact string value without explanation; do not alter punctuation, case or whitespace.

scale.description: Scale actually used by the implementation.

implementedRounding.description: Actual rounding enum constant, using its simple constant name without the enum owner. Use only its simple identifier; omit package, owner, receiver, arguments, signature and explanation.

assembler.description: InvoiceAssembler method assembling the invoice. Use only its simple identifier; omit package, owner, receiver, arguments, signature and explanation.

policy.description: Amount conversion or settlement method called by that assembler. Use only its simple identifier; omit package, owner, receiver, arguments, signature and explanation.

field.description: Invoice field storing the converted amount. Use only its simple identifier; omit package, owner, receiver, arguments, signature and explanation.
Validated pet-name field. Use only its simple identifier; omit package, owner, receiver, arguments, signature and explanation.

blankCode.description: Error code for a blank name. Return the exact string value without explanation; do not alter punctuation, case or whitespace.

longCode.description: Error code for an overlong name. Return the exact string value without explanation; do not alter punctuation, case or whitespace.

newOnly.description: Whether type validation applies only to new pets.

birthDateNewOnly.description: Whether the null birth-date check also applies only to new pets.

method.description: Validator method deciding supported classes. Use only its simple identifier; omit package, owner, receiver, arguments, signature and explanation.

comparison.description: Method used for the class comparison, not its complete call expression. Use only its simple identifier; omit package, owner, receiver, arguments, signature and explanation.

acceptsSubclass.description: Whether subclasses of the pet class are accepted.

name.description: Name assigned to the ordinary parameter described by the question. Return the exact string value without explanation; do not alter punctuation, case or whitespace.

specialType1.description: First short special-parameter class name in alphabetical order. Use only its simple identifier; omit package, owner, receiver, arguments, signature and explanation.

specialType2.description: Second short special-parameter class name in alphabetical order. Use only its simple identifier; omit package, owner, receiver, arguments, signature and explanation.

listKey.description: Built-in key specific to a List argument. Return the exact string value without explanation; do not alter punctuation, case or whitespace.

collectionKey.description: Built-in key shared by collection arguments. Return the exact string value without explanation; do not alter punctuation, case or whitespace.

arrayKey.description: Built-in key for an array argument. Return the exact string value without explanation; do not alter punctuation, case or whitespace.

addsActualName.description: Whether an available actual parameter name is also added as a map key.

guard.description: The positive collision-detection expression: true exactly when a generated generic name already exists among user parameter names. Return this predicate, not the negated condition that permits insertion, and omit the enclosing if and prose.

prefix.description: Prefix used for generated generic parameter names. Return the exact string value without explanation; do not alter punctuation, case or whitespace.

firstNumber.description: First numeric suffix appended to that prefix.

method.description: Helper implementing camel-case separation. Use only its simple identifier; omit package, owner, receiver, arguments, signature and explanation.

result.description: Exact return value for the concrete input in the question; trace every input character in the implementation. Return the exact string value without explanation; do not alter punctuation, case or whitespace.
Exact return value for the concrete naming-policy input. Return the exact string value without explanation; do not alter punctuation, case or whitespace.

locale.description: Locale constant used for case conversion, without its owner. Use only its simple identifier; omit package, owner, receiver, arguments, signature and explanation.

helper.description: Helper implementing camel-case word separation. Use only its simple identifier; omit package, owner, receiver, arguments, signature and explanation.

first.description: Exact return value for the first input. Return the exact string value without explanation; do not alter punctuation, case or whitespace.

second.description: Exact return value for the second input. Return the exact string value without explanation; do not alter punctuation, case or whitespace.

method.description: Method computing recipient count. Use only its simple identifier; omit package, owner, receiver, arguments, signature and explanation.

countUnit.description: Counting unit. Use subscriptions for subscription entries, or distinct_channels for distinct channel identifiers. Choose by the implementation; do not add prose or translate the token.

entry.description: Audience-query entry method. Use only its simple identifier; omit package, owner, receiver, arguments, signature and explanation.

delegate.description: Counting method called by the entry. Use only its simple identifier; omit package, owner, receiver, arguments, signature and explanation.

field.description: Subscription field storing the channel identifier. Use only its simple identifier; omit package, owner, receiver, arguments, signature and explanation.

entry.description: Transfer submission entry method. Use only its simple identifier; omit package, owner, receiver, arguments, signature and explanation.

field.description: Command field passed to the transfer method. Use only its simple identifier; omit package, owner, receiver, arguments, signature and explanation.

callee.description: Invoked transfer method. Use only its simple identifier; omit package, owner, receiver, arguments, signature and explanation.

returnType.description: Declared return type of offset calculation, using a simple type name. Use only its simple identifier; omit package, owner, receiver, arguments, signature and explanation.

entry.description: Entry method forwarding PageRequest fields to offset calculation. Use only its simple identifier; omit package, owner, receiver, arguments, signature and explanation.

arguments.description: Simple field names in the actual call argument order. Omit receiver names and return strings only; never sort this array.

equality.description: Comparison strategy: equals means value equality; identity means the same object reference.

direction.description: Full scan direction. Use the hyphenated token describing the iteration order, not just its starting end.

count.description: Number of matching entries removed by one successful call.

clearsReferences.description: Whether clear removes old element references.

shrinksArray.description: Whether clear shrinks the backing array.

method.description: Iterator method throwing on exhaustion. Use only its simple identifier; omit package, owner, receiver, arguments, signature and explanation.

exception.description: Exception short class name, without its package. Use only its simple identifier; omit package, owner, receiver, arguments, signature and explanation.

message.description: Exact exception message string. Return the exact string value without explanation; do not alter punctuation, case or whitespace.
